sloka: परिभ्रमति चित्राणि मण्डलानि विनिष्पतन् ।समुद्वीक्ष्य च सर्वे तम् मृगा ये अन्ये वनेचराः ॥३-४२-२८॥
transliteration: paribhramati citrāṇi maṇḍalāni viniṣpatan ।samudvīkṣya ca sarve tam mṛgā ye anye vanecarāḥ ॥3-42-28॥

translations.english: Seeing the deer, other animals wandering in the forest come near and sniffing him run away in all ten directions.
